name: lg_dependencies_installed
rubric: The OpenTelemetry logs SDK and OTLP exporter packages for this platform, or the PostHog SDK where it has native log support, are added with the package manager's install command and appear in the dependency manifest. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: lg_exporter_configured
rubric: An OTLP log exporter, or the SDK's native log capture, is configured to send logs to PostHog's log ingest endpoint on the PostHog host, authenticated with the project token, following PostHog's documentation for this platform. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: lg_token_host_env
rubric: The project token and host or endpoint are read from environment variables, not hard-coded, and the endpoint is on the same PostHog host as the rest of the app's PostHog configuration. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: lg_existing_logging_preserved
rubric: PostHog log export is added alongside the app's existing logging. Existing handlers, transports, and outputs still work, and the app's logger is reused, not replaced. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: lg_structured_properties
rubric: Logs the change adds or routes carry structured key-value properties, not only interpolated message strings. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.

name: lg_initialized_once
rubric: Log export is set up once at startup, before the app starts handling work, not per request. Judge only the changes this session made. Answer pass for YES or N/A, fail for NO.
